entities.summary: Wasiu Omogbolahan Olasunkanmi Adewale Ayinde Marshal, known professionally as K1 De Ultimate, is a Nigerian Fuji musician. He popularised a brand of the genre based on the work of its creator, Ayinde Barrister, known as "Talazo Fuji".
